Lirael: a 23-year-old drow sorcerer, a young man, clearly male with a man's face, jaw and build, slender, dark blue-grey drow skin, pointed ears, short messy grey-white hair (never long), in a long dark hooded coat with a gold clasp over dark clothes, trousers and boots, never a dress or skirt.
Brand: a 150-year-old male dwarf artificer: short, stocky and broad like every dwarf, spry, with a long grey-white beard and wild grey hair, in a brass-and-steel power armor suit with a glowing holy core.
Sazed: a male shifter of about 45, a lean monk. A shifter is a very hairy man: an ordinary human face and build, just lithe, with normal human ears, not pointed; not a wolf, beast or werewolf, and not an elf. Sazed has a wild, swept-up dark reddish-brown mane, heavy sideburns running into a rough beard, a very hairy face and hands, yellow-green eyes behind small round spectacles. He wears a subtle, practical monk outfit: a plain dark wrap tunic belted with a cloth sash, loose trousers bound at the ankles, simple soft boots, wrapped forearms, and a plain wooden quarterstaff, all in muted dark colours.
Barry Baritone: a bulky brass-and-steel construct built from Cannith and Broadhelm tech, his body made of brass instrument parts: a domed, horn-shaped helmet head with glowing orange eyes, coiled tubing and valves across his chest, and a huge tuba bell rising from one shoulder.
Beezel: an adult halfling man in his twenties, short, with a cheeky grin, pointed ears and messy dark brown hair, in a rust-red shirt with green sleeves, a grey vest, leather fingerless bracers, leather straps and a belt pouch, a hood around his neck. A halfling or gnome is short but a grown adult, with an adult face and build, never childlike.
Bellatrix: a slender female dragonborn with red scales, a paler scaled belly, two curved dark horns, green eyes, a frilled head and a long red tail, wearing a grey strapless bandeau top, loose grey harem pants with cloud patterns, and soft red shoes.
Blazehelm: a human man in his fifties with swept-back grey hair, a dark moustache and a short greying chin beard, in full polished steel plate armour with a red cloak, carrying a tall white shield with a red stripe and his helmet under one arm, a sword at his hip.
Brokk: a stocky male dwarf with a big bushy ginger beard and moustache and short ginger hair, wearing a dark apron with tool pockets, leather and brass shoulder armour, and a huge brass mechanical gauntlet crackling with blue lightning on one arm.
Captain Dane: a female aasimar paladin with pale grey-blue skin, pointed ears, blue eyes, wavy copper-orange hair and a small silver forehead circlet, with large pale-gold glowing feathered wings, in silver plate armour with gold star emblems over a cream tabard, a greatsword over her shoulder and a kite shield with a gold compass star.
Carrk: a male shifter of about 25, lean, with tanned skin, short dark brown hair, pointed ears and amber eyes, red tribal paint stripes across his face, a tattered green hooded cloak with patches, a yellow quilted tunic with leather buckles, bandaged forearms, and a short sword at his belt.
Charlie Trundle: a jovial, stocky dwarf with pointed ears, a wide smile, bushy black eyebrows, a thick black beard and moustache and long black hair tied back, a small stud earring, wearing a cream shirt under a dark leather vest with buckled straps.
Chester: a mimic shaped like a wooden treasure chest with iron bands, a single large eye on the lid, rows of sharp teeth, a long pink tongue hanging out, and four stubby grey legs.
Click Clack: a lean, muscular male wood elf with very long flowing brown hair, long pointed ears and a short brown beard, in brown leather and fur armour trimmed with leaves and moss, a tattered green cape and fur-cuffed boots, swinging a large single-bladed battleaxe.
Clockwork: a lean silver-grey warforged with a narrow skull-like face, glowing red eyes and goggles on his head, wearing a long dark brown coat with red belts and pouches, holding a smoking pipe, with a spidery mechanical companion with scythe-like legs at his side.
Cromwell: a man in his fifties with swept-back silver-grey hair, a short grey beard and goatee and a lined face, in grey and charcoal leather armour with steel pauldrons and bracers, carrying a black longbow and a quiver of arrows.
Damron Pink: a stern human prison guard captain with a hard, lined, clean-shaven face, in a black iron nasal helmet with chain coif, black plate pauldrons and vambraces, a long mustard-yellow tabard with a dark panel bearing two gold lions, and a large dark shield.
Dandy: a small male gnome chef with reddish-brown skin, long pointed ears, a huge bushy brown moustache and sideburns, a tall white chef's hat, a white shirt, black vest and red sash, flipping eggs and sausages in a frying pan. A halfling or gnome is short but a grown adult, with an adult face and build, never childlike.
Dyll Strickland: an old, weathered man, a human drill sergeant, with short grey hair and a hard, lined face, in dark leather armour with steel pauldrons and greaves, a bandaged forearm and a longsword.
Elarian: a young male elf with long straight black hair, pale skin, sharp green eyes and long pointed ears, in a dark green high-collared robe with silver trim.
Eleanor: a young woman engineer with blonde hair in a messy bun, round glasses and brass goggles on her head, in a grey-green jacket with steel shoulder plates, light grey trousers and tall brown boots, with satchels, potion vials on her belt and a red potion flask in her hand.
Elfina: a female elf warlock with long red hair under a green hood, pointed ears, one glowing violet eye, blue rune paint across her face and tattoos on her forearms, in a fringed green poncho, dark leggings and tall brown boots, holding a dark spear-staff with a hanging chain and a glowing violet gem, and a curved dagger.
Elk: a very old male drow with dark blue-grey skin, long wild white hair, a white beard and moustache, deep lines on his face and red eyes, wearing a dark blue coat with a high collar over a white shirt, chains and gear-shaped brooches.
Ellis: a rugged half-elf man in his thirties with a broad grin, blue eyes, pointed ears, shaggy brown hair and a short brown beard, wearing a dark green tricorn-style hat with a gold band, a green high-collared coat, a blue scarf and leather straps.
Eloria: a female tiefling cleric with dark blue skin, glowing golden slit eyes and pointed ears, long dark hair with gold-tinted ends and a white streak, worn partly up in two buns, small curled horns by her ears, a gold sun emblem on her forehead and a long tail, in a white and gold robe with a white fur mantle and a sun pendant, holding a small flame in her palm.
Elric: a middle-aged human soldier with a stern, heavy-jawed face, in a steel nasal helmet and chain coif, chainmail under a green tabard trimmed in gold, a heavy mace in one hand and a sword at his belt.
Erald: an elderly, short and stout adult dwarf scribe with a monocle, wild grey hair, a long grey beard, a big curled grey moustache and bushy eyebrows, in a blue robe with orange trim, purple trousers and brown boots, loaded with a backpack of scrolls, ledgers and quills, reading a long parchment.
Faird: an old man with grey hair and a thick white beard, in a hooded blue-grey robe with gold patterned trim and teal triangle marks, a mechanical warforged prosthetic arm with teal glowing joints, and a long sword with a glowing teal edge at his side.
Falken: an old male shifter elder, broad and powerful, with long white hair and a long white beard, a cloth headband, a weathered stern face with a pale rune on his forehead, and pale runic tattoos across his bare chest and arms, a chain across his chest and a wrapped staff on his back.
Fark: a succubus, slim and pale-skinned, with long black hair, pointed ears and icy pale blue eyes; in her human disguise she wears a short dark red dress and choker necklaces, and in her true form dark leathery wings and curling horns.
Feldor Windrake: a human airship captain in his forties with ash-brown hair slicked back and two thin beaded braids hanging by his face, a thin moustache and small chin beard, a pipe clenched in his teeth and a sly half-smile, in an open white ruffled shirt, dark teal vest, a short dark cape over one shoulder, a blue sash, leather bandolier with flintlock pistols, brown gloves and boots, holding a cutlass.
Felicia Jr: a young drow woman with grey-blue skin, messy short white hair pinned up, long pointed ears and pale green eyes rimmed with red, in a black bandeau top with a violet sash over one shoulder, bandaged hands and forearms, and a brown skirt with a white cloth belt and hanging chains.
Felicia Sr: a mature drow woman with dark grey skin, curly white hair in two buns, violet-pink eyes and gold hoop earrings, in a blue wrap jacket with a purple sash and skirt and dark leggings, holding a tall wooden staff topped with an amethyst crystal and branches, and a dagger.
Fey-Lynn: a drow woman with lavender-grey skin, very long straight white hair, violet eyes and violet face markings, long pointed ears, a gold circlet with a gem, gold earrings and a gold choker, in a dark purple gown.
Filgar: a wererat in rat-man form: a thin, hunched humanoid rat with pinkish-grey skin, a long pointed snout, whiskers, big ears and a long bare tail, wearing a green shirt and trousers, a maroon vest, a stained cream apron and a belt pouch, barefoot.
Fumble Figgins: a fat, short dwarf prison guard with a big red nose, droopy eyes, a long brown beard and a braided red moustache, in a round leather helmet, fur-trimmed leather shoulder pads, studded bracers and a scale-mail skirt, holding a wooden tankard.
Gauss Hog: an old male drow, broad and muscular, with dark grey-violet skin, pointed ears, short swept-back white hair, a big white moustache and beard, glowing white eyes and dark stripe markings on his face, in dark blue-black plate armour with scale mail and tattooed arms, holding a long runed greatsword upright.
Gelard Greenly: a short, stocky wizard with a long white beard, long blond-grey hair and bushy eyebrows, in a tall floppy green pointed hat with a red band and a blue feather, long green robes and leather belts, holding a glowing open spellbook and a gnarled wooden staff with a black raven perched on it.
Gelf: a rugged human man in his late thirties with a blond undercut tied back in a short ponytail, a full blond beard, three parallel claw scars across his temple and blue-grey eyes, in a dark jacket over a plain tan shirt.
Grib Grimley: a young half-elf woman reporter with wavy sea-green hair, pointed ears, a freckled face and a sullen expression, in a cream long-sleeved blouse under a navy pinafore dress with a silver leaf belt, a small turquoise lizard on her shoulder, holding an arrow.
Gynn: a glabrezu demon: a huge, pot-bellied, muscular grey-blue body with four arms ending in long red claws, a horned, skull-like goat head, a shaggy brown fur mane over the shoulders, rune markings on the skin, a loincloth, clawed feet and a long tufted tail.
Jazz: a slim young human man in his twenties with short brown hair, a narrow moustache and a cocky look, in a navy ribbed turtleneck with a leather shoulder holster, cream jodhpur trousers, gloves and tall lace-up black boots, reading a small notebook.
Jeff: a male frog-folk druid, squat and pot-bellied with green warty skin, a pale yellow-green belly and big yellow eyes, a snail riding on his head, moss and leaf rags, strings of green beads around his neck and wrist, a small red-eyed tree frog in one hand and a gnarled wooden staff topped with mushrooms in the other.
Jyo: a young human man in his twenties, a Sentinel shapeshifter, lean, with short tousled brown hair and light stubble, in a ragged brown long cloak over a grey hooded scarf and dark blue-grey tunic with a sash and leather bracers, often with rats around his feet.
Kal Valvier: a male drow of about 23, a conscripted private, slender, with lavender-grey skin, pale teal eyes, wavy chin-length white hair, white floral tattoos on his neck and forearms and a red sigil tattoo on one forearm, an open white shirt with a loose white cravat and a dark leather corset belt under a long brown fur-collared coat, brown gloves, dark leggings with knee guards and boots, a rapier at his hip.
Keys: a male dwarf petty officer and druid who can turn into a bear, stocky and muscular, brown skin, long black hair and beard in braids with gold beads, a dark hooded cloak with a green gem clasp over black leather armour with gold trim, tattooed forearms, a short sword in each hand.
Killian: a male human Aundairian airship captain, rangy, with long brown hair tied back, a bushy moustache, a small chin tuft, a gold earring and a toothy grin, a long brown buttoned coat over an open mustard vest and orange sash, white plated leg armour and tall brown boots, a musket over one shoulder and a cutlass in hand.
Kynds: a male halfling corporal, small, with short spiky brown hair, fair skin and a large waxed brown handlebar moustache, a dark grey military jacket with gold buttons and yellow epaulettes, a brown leather strap across his chest. A halfling or gnome is short but a grown adult, with an adult face and build, never childlike.
Leff: a huge, heavily muscled adult male half-orc petty officer and ex-convict with a wide gap-toothed grin showing short yellowed lower tusks, a thin black chin beard, grey-green hairy skin covered head to toe in prison tattoos, and a bald head under a pale head wrap. Shirtless, in baggy navy-and-cream striped shorts, a wide black leather belt with a patterned pouch, and tall laced brown boxing boots.
Lirael Sr: an elderly male drow wizard and Brelish general with dark grey-blue skin, long swept-back silver-white hair, a short white beard and long pointed ears; his left eye is blood-red under a red scar, his right eye blind and milky white. A dark navy quilted greatcoat over a dark blue high collar and a brown waistcoat with a gold chain, holding a glass of red wine.
Lug Murzog: a male half-orc Sentinel petty officer, lean and muscular, green skin, short black hair, small lower tusks and a pierced face, a sleeveless blue-and-red tunic with gold discs on the shoulders, rune-marked cloth strips at his belt, wrapped forearms, a machete in one hand and clawed fingers crackling with lightning.
Mercy: a slim human woman in her late forties, a military librarian, with black cat-eye glasses, red lipstick and dark wavy hair streaked with grey, pinned up. A green cardigan over a cream polka-dot blouse with a big pointed collar and a black bow, holding a book.
Meriel: a smiling older human woman in her sixties, a military librarian, with red-framed glasses, fair lined skin, grey-brown hair in a bun and small gold earrings. A green blouse with orange floral embroidery, a yellow collar and a yellow buttoned front, holding a book.
Monty O'Brien: a grown adult male dwarf, chief of engineering on the Kingsblade, with wild swept-up brown hair, a full bushy brown beard and round brass goggles strapped around his head; stocky and broad, a weathered man's face, never childlike. Riveted leather-and-brass armour with turquoise shoulder plates and gear fittings, two brass cylinders on his back, a big warhammer.
Mr. Beaks: Mr. Beaks the pigeon, a tiny round fluffy bird: a grey-brown cap on its head, a small black eye with a dark streak behind it, a short dark beak, a puffy cream-white breast, olive-brown wings with darker barred feathers, a short tail and pink feet.
Murphy Gravewood: a muscular human blacksmith from Ardev with short tousled blond hair shaved at the sides, tanned skin, a scar across one cheek and a confident half-smile. A sleeveless white undershirt under a long dark leather smith's apron with a tool belt, a braided cord tied round one upper arm, one yellow leather work glove, olive-green trousers and brown boots, leaning on a long sledgehammer.
Mustang: an experimental warforged police unit: a humanoid construct with a grey metal skull face, glowing blue eyes and exposed brass-and-steel neck workings under a navy police cap with a gold badge. A long double-breasted navy police greatcoat with a tan belt over a cream shirt and red tie, navy trousers, brown boots, brass-and-steel hands holding a baton and a revolver.
Neer: an elderly drow woman, an old advisor of Ardev's founder, with dark purple-grey lined skin, long straight white hair with thin braids, bright pink-magenta eyes, long pointed ears and curved dark horns sweeping back from her head. Steel plate armour with a dark fur mantle.
Paxon: a slim adult male elf chief petty officer with a stern frowning face, pale skin, pointed ears and silver-white hair tied back in a low ponytail. A long royal-blue officer's coat with gold frogging, buttons and epaulettes, a white cravat, a grey waistcoat, pale grey breeches, steel greaves and sabatons, a gold-hilted sabre at his hip.
Rex: an enormous, heavily muscled adult male half-orc prison gang leader with a scowling bruised face, big lower tusks, a short dark chin beard and a bald head under a stained head wrap; grey-green hairy skin covered in tattoos, a red orc-skull sigil on one shoulder. Shirtless, in dark maroon trousers with a black belt and a big silver buckle.
Screech: a grown man in his thirties, a halfling, so short in height but an adult with a man's face and build, never childlike: a stern, weathered face with heavy brows, a thick dark moustache and dark sideburns, a brown leather aviator cap with ear flaps and green-lensed goggles pushed up on it, a dark red scarf, a heavy brown shearling-lined flight jacket, and black breathing hoses with brass pressure gauges strapped across his chest.
Scud: a gaunt adult male elf convict and pyromaniac with long straight black hair, very long pointed ears and a sullen, hollow-cheeked face. A ragged grey-brown robe over a dark red shirt, iron shackles and chains on his wrists, a small glowing flame cupped in his hands.
Sheldor: a slender adult drow man, clearly male, petty officer with a smooth, fine-boned beardless face, dark grey-blue skin, long wavy white hair falling past his chest, pale eyes and pointed ears; tattoos on his neck and swirling tattoos on one forearm. Black studded leather armour under a dark cloak, a crossbow on his back, a dagger in hand.
Shmem Gorgis: a scowling adult male human convict and tuba player with messy red hair and thick red mutton-chop sideburns joined to a short beard. A light blue shirt under a dark scaled leather vest, dark teal gloves, playing a huge brass tuba with flames bursting from its bell.
Skye: a ten-year-old shifter girl, small and wiry, with long wild brown hair tied up with a red hair tie, green eyes, pointed ears, tan skin and a long tail with a tufted tip. A sleeveless red-brown leather top with a red armband, fingerless gloves and a leather bracer, a red cloth panel over baggy teal trousers, criss-cross leg wraps, bare clawed feet, three spears on her back and a dagger in hand.
Smarmy Joe: a male bullywug (frog-folk) musician with green skin, big red bulging eyes and a little white moustache and chin beard. A sleeveless blue vest with white fleece trim over his bare green torso, salmon-red shorts, a knife at his hip, playing a purple acoustic guitar, beer bottles at his feet.
Sorenson: a short, stout grown adult male dwarf petty officer and one-man-band musician with a big swept-back red-ginger pompadour, a full bushy red beard and a big nose, singing with his eyes squeezed shut; a man's face, never childlike. A brown vest over a grey knit shirt, a green sash, baggy purple breeches with gold stripes, barefoot with leather leg wraps, playing a mandolin with a bass drum and cymbal strapped to his back.
Spingus Dillguard: a small, pot-bellied grown adult male gnome head chef with a big pink nose, rosy cheeks, bushy white brows, large pointed ears, a long white beard and a huge white moustache, and a sly grin; an old man's face, never childlike. A tall white chef's hat, a brown apron over a white shirt and dark vest, olive trousers, a pot in one hand and a long wooden spoon in the other.
Taggart: an upright, fit adult male human military police sergeant with a dark moustache and a cigarette in his mouth, under a black spiked brass-fitted helmet. A black military tunic with gold buttons, brass epaulettes and medals, a brass gear belt buckle, a mechanical brass-and-steel left arm, a black glove on his right hand holding a short firearm, tall black boots.
Tauren: a male half-orc petty officer and ex-convict, broad-shouldered, mostly human-looking but with grey-green skin, two small lower tusks and slightly pointed ears, dark slicked-back pompadour and long sideburns, a white T-shirt with a claw-and-tooth necklace, grey trousers with patched knees, a black belt with a gold buckle, brown boots, a fur-collared jacket over one shoulder, leaning on a double-bladed greataxe.
Thaddeus Cannith: an elderly half-elf man of House Cannith, lean, with pointed ears, long swept-back silver-white hair, a short white beard and moustache, pale blue eyes and a lined stern face, rich blue robes with ornate gold shoulder plates and a blue gem clasp.
Thaldamir: a very tall, slim adult male elf convict gang leader with long wavy blond hair, long pointed ears and a sharp chin, laughing with his head thrown back. A loose ochre shirt with green leaf embroidery open at the chest, a red striped sash, a long rust-orange coat trimmed with autumn leaves, brown pinstriped trousers and tall red-brown boots, a glass of red wine in hand.
The Bloodsinger: a tall, muscular male shifter druid leader who can take the form of a stag, with long brown hair and a beard under a white fur hood crowned with large antlers. Bare tanned chest with swirling tattoos, fur and leather wraps with green armbands, a white fur kilt, a tattered brown cloak, a quiver on his back, a bow in one hand and a short spear glowing with green magic in the other.
The Even Hand: an assassin in a long-beaked white plague-doctor mask and black tricorn hat, with a warforged body under dark hooded robes with red and grey panels, a studded collar, ribbed black gauntlets, a belt of pouches and a small blade in hand.
The Rat Man: a wiry adult male human with a sharp-nosed, lined, wide-eyed face under a dark brown hood, a long ragged brown cloak, a red tunic and pointed brown boots, rats riding on his shoulders, playing a long bone flute with a swarm of red-eyed rats around his feet.
Turckle: a stout, broad adult male dwarf innkeeper with a ruddy smiling face, red hair swept back into braids, and a long brown braided beard and moustache; a grown man's face, never childlike. A brown leather vest over a blue shirt, tattooed forearms with leather bracers, holding mugs of beer at his bar.
Wilford Chism: an older heavyset human man, head of the Silver Flame church in Ardev, with a round ruddy face and double chin, a big bushy white handlebar moustache, round wire glasses, blue eyes and grey hair at the temples. A wide-brimmed yellow hat, a teal collared shirt and orange suspenders.
Xera: a young, smiling drow woman with dark grey skin, wavy silver-white hair in a loose low ponytail over one shoulder, pale blue eyes and pointed ears. A black choker with a gold star pendant, a dark wrap top over a cream blouse with big balloon sleeves patterned with black flames at the cuffs, a long dark skirt.
Zenya: a curvy young drow woman with blue-grey skin, short tousled white hair, red eyes, pointed ears and dark lipstick. An off-shoulder purple laced bodice with striped puffed sleeves and long purple arm sleeves, cream bloomers, a brown belt, thigh-high brown stockings and heeled boots.
Neebus: a male parrot-folk cook, a humanoid parrot with teal-green feathers and wings for arms, a green crest, a white face with an orange cheek patch and a large black hooked beak, a navy-blue gold-trimmed long coat with gold epaulettes, a white cravat, white breeches, black clawed bird feet, a sword at his hip.
Auntie Bees: a human woman beekeeper, plump, with dark hair, round glasses and a smile, a wide beekeeper's hat with a honeycomb veil and a bee on top, a frilly honey-yellow-and-white layered dress with black-and-yellow striped sleeves and a red sash, a honey-pot device in one hand and a honey-dipper staff, swirls of bees around her.
Morganth: a big, broad male red dragonborn mercenary leader with red scaled skin, a horned dragon head with curved horns and long dark red hair hanging down his back. Heavy steel plate armour with big pauldrons, a blue cloak, a large single-bladed greataxe across his lap.
Topek: a wereshark in hybrid form: a hulking humanoid great white shark with a gaping jaw of jagged teeth, a red eye, grey-blue skin with a white belly, a dorsal fin and tail, clawed webbed hands and feet. A tattered brown vest, a necklace of shark teeth, a spiked leather bracer, a black belt and torn brown trousers.
Wylon: a wereshark in hybrid form: a hulking humanoid great white shark with a gaping jaw of jagged teeth, a red eye, grey-blue skin with a white belly, a dorsal fin and tail, clawed webbed hands and feet. A tattered brown vest, a necklace of shark teeth, a spiked leather bracer, a black belt and torn brown trousers. (Topek's twin in look)
Art Broadhelm: a stocky male dwarf artificer, bald on top with a tall red topknot ponytail, round brass goggles over his eyes, a big red beard bound by a gold ring, blue-grey plate armour with heavy gold-trimmed pauldrons over a long blue tabard, a wide belt with a skull buckle and pouches, brown gloves and tall boots, carrying a huge blue-steel mechanical warhammer with gold bands and gold flame decoration.
Bulwark Broadhelm: a towering, heavily built warforged in dark grey and silver plating, a smooth masked face with glowing teal eyes and a glowing rune on the brow, carrying a huge rectangular tower shield and a great rune-carved warhammer set with a blue orb.
Baron Hellsauce: a brutish green-skinned orc with a heavy brow, big tusks and pierced ears with hoops and chains, a dark mohawk of spiky hair, black sunglasses and a red jacket.
Rolick: a young adult male elf ranger with short blond hair, pointed ears, bright green eyes and a worried, flushed face. A green hooded cloak, a quiver of arrows on his back, gripping a long wooden staff.
EEEEE: an old male dwarf, short, stout and round like every dwarf, a grown adult with an old man's face, never childlike: a big bulbous red nose, wide eyes, big pointed ears, rosy cheeks, bushy white eyebrows and a full white curling moustache and beard, a long floppy brown stocking cap whose tip curls behind him, a loose mustard-yellow tunic tied at the neck and cinched with a wide black leather belt with a brass buckle, grey trousers, curled brown boots, and a miner's pickaxe.
Byll: a slim adult male elf-like prison guard with flat ash-grey skin, long pointed ears, short swept white hair, a thin white goatee and round pink-tinted spectacles, a dark navy top hat with a sprig of pink blossoms in the band. A high-collared navy tunic with black frog fastenings, an olive-green poncho cape embroidered with pink flowers, dark grey patched breeches, navy riding boots, a quiver of pink-fletched arrows at his hip and a gnarled, curling wooden longbow.
Cyriel: a slim adult male elf-like prison guard with flat ash-grey skin, long pointed ears, white hair pulled up into a top knot, a thin white goatee and round pink-tinted spectacles, a pink blossom tucked by one ear, and coarse grey hair on his bare shins. A high-collared navy tunic with black frog fastenings and patched elbows, dark grey patched knee breeches, navy boots, brown gloves, a quiver of pink-fletched arrows at his hip and a gnarled, curling wooden longbow.
Nedira: a male shifter of about 40, the airship's chief petty officer: a tall, broad-shouldered man with an ordinary human face and build, just very hairy, not a wolf, beast or werewolf. A hard, scowling face with deep brow lines, piercing yellow eyes, slightly pointed ears, long shaggy dark brown hair swept back, and a thick dark beard greying at the chin. A thick tawny fur mantle over dark blue-steel scale and plate armour with gold trim, a dark blue tabard, chainmail sleeves, and a gold claw-shaped brooch at the shoulder.
Archimedes: a warforged mechanical owl the size of a large bird of prey, built from riveted copper and bronze plates with a green verdigris patina: a pale, polished barn-owl face disc with glowing blue eyes and a small hooked beak, broad wings of articulated metal feather-plates, jointed metal legs with steel talons, and thin blue glowing seams between the plates.
Bloodworth: a huge, brutish male half-orc prison officer in his fifties with weathered pinkish-tan skin, a heavy scowling brow, a broad flat nose, a jutting lower jaw with two short tusks, scars across his forehead, pointed ears with iron rings, grey stubble, and lank greasy dark hair slicked back. A spiked iron circlet with one long curved horn-like spike over his brow, a shaggy brown fur mantle, and battered, blood-spattered spiked plate and leather armour strapped with buckles, carrying a heavy rusted cleaver of a sword.
Captain Flowers: a tall, broad male half-orc police captain in his forties with dusky grey skin, pointed ears, short underbite tusks, small wire-rimmed spectacles, neatly combed brown hair and a trimmed brown beard. A dark brown greatcoat with a short shoulder cape and gold-fringed epaulettes, a gold-and-brown brocade waistcoat over a white shirt, buff breeches, tall black boots, brown leather gloves and bracers, and a curved sabre at his hip.
Chaton: a lean male tabaxi, a cat-folk station master: an orange-furred catlike face with sharp green cat eyes, a pink nose, a sly toothy grin, a long drooping ginger moustache, huge wild tufts of orange fur flaring from his cheeks, and tall orange cat ears poking around a black peaked conductor's cap. A black double-breasted tailcoat, white wing-collar shirt, a red bow tie, black trousers, white gloves, polished black shoes, and a leather ledger pouch at his belt.
Chief Torg: a hulking, heavyset military police chief in his fifties with sallow greyish-green skin, a thick neck, a heavy jaw, a short dark beard, small wire-rimmed spectacles perched on his nose, short dark hair, and a cigarette in his mouth. A rumpled grey shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a loose dark tie, black braces, dark trousers and scuffed work boots.
Dell Quickfoot: a large male tortle, an upright turtle-man reporter: a big domed olive-green shell stuck all over with scraps of handwritten notes, a pale tan plastron, scaly olive-green limbs with blunt claws, a beaked turtle face with heavy brows and amber eyes, and a short tail. A battered brown fedora with a note tucked in the band, a red leather satchel on a long shoulder strap, a knotted rope belt, a gold wristwatch, a blue pen in one hand and a red press pass in the other.
Ember: a 150-year-old female dwarf artificer, Brand's twin sister: short, stocky and broad like every dwarf, a grown adult with a woman's face and build, never childlike. Fair freckled skin, golden-yellow eyes, a faint scar across the cheek, short red-ginger sideburn fuzz along her jaw, and thick copper-red hair worked into a braided bun with two long braids tied with brass hex-nut rings. A cream wrap tunic with a red patterned sash across the chest, brass shoulder pauldron, bracers, knee guards and boots, dark trousers, a brown tool apron hung with wrenches, pliers and a hammer, a leather satchel, a strap of glowing vials, and a brass gear-wheel torch gadget in her gloved hand.
Grail Grimdell: a thin, pale adult male human necromancer with a gaunt, sharp-featured face, sunken dark eyes, a faint smile and black hair falling from under a deep black hood. A long black hooded robe with wide sleeves, a large blood-red gem pendant on a silver chain with small red stones at the collar, and a tall gnarled wooden staff topped with a human skull.
Helena Braithwind: a slender female tiefling reporter in her thirties with deep cobalt-blue skin, two dark blue curved horns, glowing gold eyes, pointed ears, long wavy black hair, and a long blue tail ending in an arrowhead spade. One forearm is covered in a gold crescent-moon pattern. A white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, a brown leather camera strap across her chest, khaki trousers with a dark belt, brown boots, a wrapped-hilt sword slung across her back, and a boxy black camera held up in both hands.
Joerick: an adult male human prison guard, the halberdier of the pair, with a stern clean-shaven face half hidden under a rounded steel kettle helm with a nasal guard. Polished steel breastplate, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves over a long quilted dark-green surcoat split to the knee, a brown leather belt, and a long halberd with a broad axe blade and spike.
Spingel: an adult male human prison guard, the archer of the pair, with a stern clean-shaven face half hidden under a rounded steel kettle helm. Steel breastplate, pauldrons and greaves over a long quilted dark-green surcoat split to the knee, brown leather belts and straps, a quiver of arrows on his back, and a recurve longbow in hand.
Shrimp Diggery: a small, wizened old male imp, about the size of a child but an old devil, never childlike: gaunt, wiry red-orange skin speckled with pale spots, a bony skull-like face with glowing red eyes, a jagged fanged grin, short curved horns, big swept-back pointed ears, ragged bat wings with yellow membranes, clawed hands and feet, and a long thin tail ending in a barbed hook.
The Bear: a male shifter of about 35, a tall, burly warrior of the Emberfall Covenant: an ordinary human face and build, just very hairy, not a wolf, beast or werewolf. Long straight auburn-brown hair with thin braids at the temples, a thick reddish-brown beard, and brown eyes. A huge shaggy cream bear-fur cloak, riveted wooden-and-leather plate armour carved with spiral patterns, a knotted dark-green sash, a fang necklace, a drinking horn and a hand axe at his belt, a quiver on his back and a red-gripped longbow over his shoulder.
The Skull Knight: a towering undead knight with a bare silver-grey skull face, glowing red eye sockets and a spiked crown-like helm, in black plate armour sculpted like ribs and bone with a spiny fur-like spiked mantle and a long tattered black cloak. He carries a sword sheathed in a spiralling, glowing pink crystalline thorn-encrusted scabbard, and rides a gaunt, armoured black undead horse with a skeletal, rotted head.
Warden Sharpe: a short, stout, older male human prison warden in his sixties, bald on top with a fringe of white hair, a heavy jowled scowling face and thick black-rimmed glasses. A dark charcoal suit with a white shirt, a red tie and a red rose pinned to the lapel, standing with his hands clasped behind his back.
